title: Decimal notation
text:
Decimal notation is the standard base-10 system for writing numbers, using a decimal point to separate whole numbers (left of the point, like ones, tens) from fractional parts (right of the point, like tenths, hundredths). Each digit's position signifies a power of 10, making it easy to represent any real number, whether it's a whole number, a terminating fraction (e.g., 0.5), or a repeating one (e.g., 0.333...).
